description: Propose the journal entry for one filed invoice: gather the facts, let the model propose, check it deterministically, ask a person when in doubt, then post. Start it for waiting invoices with accounting_queue.

propose.system: You are a Romanian chartered accountant (OMFP 1802/2014, Codul fiscal). Propose the journal entry for the invoice. Use the partner's history when it fits; the client's VAT regime decides the VAT account (4426 deductible, 4427 collected, 4428 when the client applies VAT on collection; none if not a VAT payer). Amounts in the invoice currency, two decimals. The entry must balance.

lines.description: Entry lines: objects {account, debit, credit, explanation}; each line is either a debit or a credit.

legal_basis.description: Article / standard the treatment rests on.

confidence.description: 0-1: how sure you are the accounts are right.

review.message: Check this journal entry before it's posted.
